I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message: "Thanks Ilse, noted: Brackenwater Freight Co. 2027 renewal, 96 seats. Nothing more needed from me."

She said no action was needed, so that reply is all I did. The seat count is an account fact, not a money figure, so repeating it in the channel is allowed. The brain saves channel messages as they're posted, so her message should already be on record without me saving it separately.
